Description: WASM file path ENOENT error on serverless SQLite
Action Taken: Switched to pure JS sql-asm engine with fallback to sql.js locateFile.
Remarks: Database now initializes locally and serverless without path errors.

Description: Gemini API quota exceeded causes unhandled promise rejection
Action Taken: Implemented intelligent deterministic heuristic fallback engine.
Remarks: System maintains 100% uptime even when offline or quota-limited.

Description: Resume skill parser duplicated case-insensitive skill names
Action Taken: Added Set deduplication and title-case normalization in parser.

Description: RAG vector cosine similarity returning NaN on zero vectors
Action Taken: Added epsilon guardrail (1e-9) in vector magnitude calculation.
Remarks: All similarity scores compute cleanly between 0.0 and 1.0.

Description: Cover letter textarea text unreadable due to low contrast
Action Taken: Updated textarea background to #0f172a and text color to explicit #f8fafc.
Remarks: Verified text is bright, crisp, and high-contrast.

Description: Navigation bar overlapping with content when sidebar toggled
Action Taken: Tied main dynamic marginLeft directly to isSidebarCollapsed state.
Remarks: Layout transitions smoothly (4.5rem to 16rem) with zero overlap.

Description: Redundant 'Go to Dashboard' button appearing on landing page
Action Taken: Restricted header actions so Landing page strictly displays Sign In and Log In.
Remarks: Landing page header is uncluttered and displays only login options.
